title: Nectar of the Divine Spell
description: Sakura, the last surviving princess of a fallen kingdom, is being hunted down for the power of Ambrosia she possesses - the ability to grant divine strength, but only to a human. With no human companion, she decides to summon one from another world in a desperate attempt to find a knight to protect her, but the man who answers her call is less than what she had hoped for.
author: Yoshino Hiroyuki

title: Register!
description: How young is too young to fall in love? How old is too old to fall in love? Who decides the end of the flowery days of youth and the beginning of the same? In the eastern part of Tokyo, at a supermarket in a town zero meters above sea level. A chance encounter for two people over the cashier's counter.
author: Fujimaru

title: Artemis Under the Same Roof
description:
A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!?

Poor university student Sanosuke Saraki unexpectedly reunites with his admired genius classmate, Koharu Kobachi, at his part-time job back at his old school. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who has repeated her second year in a row...! Saraki's mission is to "make Koharu graduate by the end of the year."
author: Uraya Nagi

title: Sunset of Passion
description:
What happens when next door to upcoming mangaka Fujiwara moves Yuuki, who was his teacher back in high school and first crush?

Yuuki, now a married woman, is starting a new life in the city, however her husband is always away on business trips. She finds comfort in the company of her former student, but what she doesn't realize is that Fujiwara can listen to everything happening in her apartment through the building's thin walls...
author: Tsuyatsuya

title: Transmigrating into a Cultivation Novel to Form a Harem
description: Shi Nidie transmigrated into the mistress of the Pleasure Palace! Originally, she planned on surviving by:  guiding the overpowered male lead Nie Guixun on his path to become a hero, help ignite passion in the lazy prodigal He Lanshan, change the tragic fate of the tsundere Dan Jiudeng, and save the loyal dog Yun Lin from certain death. To carry out her plan, she decided to take all four in as disciples, founding a new sect which defied fate and aimed to rewrite destiny. Watch Shi Nidie as she embarks on her chaotic journey of building a reverse-harem. Where she expands and strengthens the power of the Pleasure Palace!
author: Hui Jingshe (绘境社)

title: Juumonji in Sight!
description:
Asahi Nishizono has finally made her high school debut. But ever since she was a little girl, she's never been able to forget her first love, You Kazami. Even now, she can't take her eyes off his handsome face...

...or so she thought, until a huge shadow suddenly blocks her view.

“WHOA! JUUMONJI?!”

That's Touya Juumonji, Kazami's childhood friend who's always by his side. Not only is he huge, he's also ridiculously talented at all sorts of things. And somehow, Juumonji always manages to steal Nishizono's view of Kazami...?!
author: Itsutsuse

title: Permission of Bite
description: Caelius , a high-ranking lord among vampire nobility, undergoes an unexpected transformation while investigating anomalies within their territory. During the crisis, they cross paths with a young werewolf named Rehgar, forming an inextricable bond. Though their races are sworn enemies, the two are forced to embark on a journey together to uncover the truth behind the hidden darkness festering within the vampire realm. Along the way, their connection evolves from a mere contractual relationship into that of inseparable soulmates.
author: 枕咪文娱

title: Blue Flames
description: Ryuuichi is a high-school student tired of living in a small town with small people. He'll do whatever he can to get money, power, and women.
author: Yanagisawa Kimio

title: I Don't Want to Ascend
description:
Sealed inside a secret realm for three hundred years, the notorious archvillain has finally been released by a massive fool. Jin Xun bursts into a wild laughter. He prepares to make his triumphant return and settle an old grudge— huh? What happened to his maxed-out cultivation level? What happened to all of his divine-grade artifacts? Why is no one obeying his commands anymore?! 

As long as Su Yuan stays by Jin Xu's side, her constantly depleting cultivation returns to normal. In order to survive, Su Yuan decides to tightly cling onto Jin Xun by offering him every treasure in the world— as long as he stays by her side, of course. However, just being near her makes Jin Xun lose all of his powers and causes him to become as weak as an ordinary person. In order to seek his revenge, he has to leave her... Until Su Yuan tightly binds him with her Immortal-binding rope.

Su Yuan: Quit struggling. In this lifetime, you and I are never going to be apart!
Jin Xun: I'll never give up my quest for revenge just for the sake of love!   
(A few days later…)  
Jin Xun: Fine, I accept you.
Su Yuan: ？？？？？？
author: R11

title: Girl and Science
description: They were childhood friends, and she had always been more powerful than him. But when they accidentally traveled (summoned?) to another world, it was finally time for him to become the knight in shining armor! He had to find her first though, since they were separated… Come and witness his fight to be better in a crazy world where monsters roamed and technology was so advanced your amputated limbs could be restored to perfection…
author: 诈术师德德

title: Sweet Cohabitation Romcom with My Senior Girlfriend and Alcohol Starts at Twenty
description:
Kureha Senpai, who loves alcohol, becomes even more enchanting and seductive once she starts drinking... my reasoning is about to explode! The two of us, deeply caring for each other, grow bolder in our affection whether we’re drinking at home or out, using every trick in the book to flirt and get closer!
___
**Character Designer:** [Monoto](https://mangadex.org/author/96b3bbe2-e878-4dee-9573-26aadbc78b3f)
author: Kobaya J

title: I Hate That We're Childhood Friends!: My Rise to the Top of School Life with an S-Rank Beauty Begins After a Falling-Out
description: Kazuma Suzuki was just your average high schooler—until his childhood friend, Rua Takayashiki, a beautiful, sharp-tongued girl who also happened to be the granddaughter of the school chairman and the nation's top idol, cut all ties with him using a line straight out of a drama. Forced into submission for years as her so-called childhood friend, Kazuma decides it's finally time for his first-ever rebellion. He's done playing lapdog. This time, he's taking back his freedom—and aiming for a normal school life. Escaping a powerful beauty like her is easier said than done...
author: Yuuji Yuuji

title: Never Mind
description: A story about a high school girl who fell for her childhood friend.
author: NETS

title: Made In Abyss
description:
The enormous cave system, known as the Abyss, is the last unexplored place in the world. Nobody knows how deep down goes this titanic pit, inhabited by strange and wondrous creatures and full of mysterious ancient relics which purpose in unknown to modern man. Generations of bold adventurers have been drawn by the cryptic depths of the Abyss. In course of time those brave enough to explore the dangerous pit came to be known as "Delvers."

In Orth, the town at the edge of the Abyss, there lives a little orphan named Riko, who dreams of becoming as great a delver as her mother was and solving the great mystery of the pit. One day, exploring the murky depths, she stumbles upon a little boy who turns out to be a robot...
author: Tsukushi Akihito

title: Comic Girls
description: The story concerns the daily life of young up-and-coming mangaka living together in an all-female dormitory.
author: Hanzawa Kaori

title: Hiroin-kun
description: The story of a boy, Akira Hiroin whose mother always wanted a daughter. His father, a scientist, makes him take (without knowing) a remedy that turns him into a girl.
author: Yoshikawa Susumu

title: Will You Marry Me Because I Quit Being an Idol?
description:
Sato Itto, an ordinary salaryman, has been shy about love due to an old trauma. Then one day, a reunion is held for the first time in several years. While they are having a good time talking about the good old days, suddenly Hebo, who has become an idol currently on hiatus, decides to attend the reunion!

Sato is upset to see Hebo, who was his first love. He manages to get over it with the help of alcohol, which he does not normally drink. When he wakes up, he finds the two of them naked in the same bed. As Sato desperately tries to recall his memories, Hebo shockingly says to him...!

"Marry me..."

What will happen to the marriage between the two who have no experience with love...!?
author: Miyoshi Shiomi

title: Wakaba Won't Give Up!
description:
One tomboy is determined to win the heart of her childhood best friend–but will it take more than a makeover to win him over?

Wakaba is cocky, condescending, foul-mouthed, and absolutely in love with her childhood friend, Daiki. For as long as they’ve known each other, Wakaba’s been the very image of a roughhousing tomboy, but all that’s about to change. When she shows up in front of him, wearing a cutesy, feminine outfit, will she get the hopeless late bloomer’s heart racing? When you can’t put your feelings into words, an image change might just be the right gambit!

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*
author: Konkichi

title: Ex vs. Stalker
description:
Kidnapped by her ex-boyfriend, only the stalker is in the know!  
  
The fitting model Ju Yeon, who had just emerged as a star on social media, wakes up to find herself tied up in a dark school. Her kidnapper, a man named Nam Woo, is her ex-boyfriend. Ju Yeon had just reached a turning point in her life. But while she was being threatened by her ex-boyfriend at that moment, Ju Yeon's stalker, Park Su, was watching the two while keeping his mouth shut inside the shadows!
author: 양욱
